title: 12-model climate ensemble fan (SSP1-2.6 vs SSP3-7.0)
what: By 2100 SSP3-7.0 median reaches +4.34 °C vs +1.75 °C under SSP1-2.6 (+2.60 °C gap across 12 models)

reader_questions.question: What is the 2100 median warming gap between SSP3-7.0 and SSP1-2.6?
How is inter-model uncertainty shown?
reader_questions.expected: Shaded envelope (10th–90th percentile / IQR / SD) across 12 climate models.

reader_questions.question: When do the two scenario envelopes clearly separate?
reader_questions.expected: Around mid-century (2045–2055), after which SSP1-2.6 stabilizes below 2 °C while SSP3-7.0 accelerates.
